checks: Independently expanded the convolution difference b_j²−b_(j−1)b_(j+1). For the middle term, whenever its subtracted product is positive, contiguity allows division and the first consecutive ratio dominates the last. If that product is zero the bracket is nonnegative directly. Multiplication by a zero coordinate preserves the support.

The identity e₂=(1−s)/2 gives 0≤e₂<1. The consecutive ratios with positive denominators bound e₃,e₄,… by e₂²,e₂³,… respectively. If e₂>0, finite support gives a strict comparison to the infinite geometric sum. Multiplying 2+e₂+e₂²/(1−e₂) by 2(1−e₂) gives 3+s.

If e₂=0, all pairwise products vanish and sum one forces exactly one positive coordinate. This includes length one and arbitrary appended zeros. Source 4ac6f62135b1565c §2 (2) gives exactly this statement and equality criterion.
readability: The proof of coefficient log-concavity applies to any finite sequence of nonnegative variables, as needed by the same-wave scalar tail argument.
